The test conditions of water resistance include: For IP68: submersion in static freshwater up to a depth of 2 meters, up to 72 hours, with a temperature delta between the water and product being 5K or less. For IP69/IP69K: spraying the enclosure with a stream of water from a standard test nozzle; turntable speed of 5(±1) r/min; spray positions of 0°, 30°, 60°, 90°; test duration of 30 seconds per position; water flow rate of 15(±1) L/min with a water temperature of 80℃.
